stories.title: LSU leaves ex-pros off roster for Clemson opener
stories.summary: Dae'Quan Wright and Zxavian Harris, who were cleared earlier this week to return to college football after brief stints in the NFL, have not been added to LSU's roster for its season opener against Clemson.

stories.title: WVU retires record-setting QB White's No. 5 jersey
stories.summary: Pat White's record-setting career at West Virginia two decades ago came full circle Saturday when the school retired his No. 5 jersey.

stories.title: Canes WR Toney puts on show in record opener
stories.summary: Miami's Malachi Toney started his sophomore campaign in electric fashion, delivering 12 catches for a school-record 234 yards and three touchdowns to lead the Hurricanes to a 45-6 blowout of Stanford.

stories.title: Williams sisters reunite, thrill N.Y. in 3-set loss
stories.summary: Serena and Venus Williams are out of the US Open women's doubles after losing to Hao-Ching Chan and Maya Joint in a third-set tiebreaker.

stories.title: Gasly stuns at Monza again with first-ever pole
stories.summary: Alpine's Pierre Gasly has taken pole position in a sensational qualifying for Sunday's Italian Grand Prix.
